name: University of Ljubljana FRI modular rooftop data center
developer: University of Ljubljana Faculty of Computer and Information Science; NTR Inzeniring
notes: DCD reported that the Faculty of Computer and Information Science in Ljubljana is getting a containerized rooftop data center supplied by NTR Inzeniring for AI/LLM research; cost is about EUR 2.5m and MW capacity was not disclosed.

name: ARNES Ljubljana-area redundancy data centre

name: Posta Slovenije new data centre for Ministry of Digital Transformation
notes: PostEurop/Pošta source and DCD report that Posta Slovenije handed over a new data centre to Slovenia's Ministry of Digital Transformation at the end of September 2025; Finance reporting identifies it as a Ljubljana facility and the second Posta data center in Ljubljana, but public sources did not disclose MW capacity.

name: ARNES Maribor Data Centre / Slovenian AI Factory
notes: ARNES bought a site near the Maribor Island hydro plant and began construction in May 2025. The data centre is planned for open science storage, colocation for universities/research institutions, a new supercomputer and the Slovenian AI Factory; DCD reports EUR 18m data-centre investment and expected completion/test operations around mid/summer 2026. MW capacity was not disclosed.
